guide.title: How to use the admin
guide.description: What works today, the shortest path for sellers, and how the chat button opens the right screen.
guide.intro: This pilot stores data locally (SQLite). All create / edit / delete actions use forms on each menu page. The assistant chat **opens the right page** so you can click Save or set status yourself. Full AI actions require VClaw when configured.
guide.realtimeHeading: What works in the admin today
guide.realtimeIntro: These areas already have real forms or lists (not only mock content):
realtimeBullets: Overview: four KPIs, recent orders, two DB-fed lists — all from SQLite.
Inbox /admin/inbox: same Task table as the overview widget; Approve → DONE, Reject → IGNORED.
Onboarding & shop settings: name, QR, operating hints.
Products: add / edit / delete / archive / image URL.
Orders: list, create from admin, change status.
Payments: list, update status, bill notes.
Bookings: create / browse by day (?date=), cancel when needed.
Shipping: real per-order notes; carrier list is PRD mock.
Settings: shop summary from DB with link to Onboarding.
Integrations (/admin/settings): channel hub — Zalo/Facebook/Shopee OAuth (browser then return to the app), GHTK via API token + form; automation queue lives under Automation.
Reports: headline totals + order/payment status counts (live); dashed box = PRD mock; SKU CSV export is live.

botRoadmap.title: Bot & webview direction (future)
botRoadmap.intro: Goal: the assistant maps to this admin surface, then opens webviews/tools for connected systems. Today the pilot only routes inside the app; next steps need APIs and strict trust boundaries.
bullets: Posting / customer care: channel content APIs + approval policy; webview could be Meta / Zalo Business after OAuth.
Orders / QR: forms exist on Orders + Onboarding; a future bot could call scoped server actions via the gateway.
COD shipping: needs carrier adapters + normalized address; today only per-order shipping notes in-app.
Webviews: usually external seller consoles (Shopee, Zalo OA) — watch sessions/cookies and never store passwords in the bot.

laterBullets.body: Integrations save connection state; there is no one-click “post for me” yet. Pilot: compose on the channel or export SKU CSV from Reports.

laterBullets.body: Inbox in the app is internal tasks + demo UI; wiring Zalo/Messenger is a later step.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Channel connection hub: Zalo / Facebook / Shopee use OAuth (browser login at the provider, then return to VClaw with tokens saved). GHTK uses an API token from the GHTK portal plus the form below — there is no OAuth redirect like Meta.

integrationPanel.title: Connection status
integrationPanel.hint: Zalo / Facebook / Shopee: click OAuth → sign in on the provider → you are sent back to VClaw; tokens are stored in SQLite (ChannelConnection). Telegram: manual flag only. GHTK: open the GHTK portal in a new tab, copy the API token, paste into the form (no OAuth).
integrationPanel.oauthUnavailable: If OAuth fails: set ZALO_OA_APP_ID and ZALO_OA_APP_SECRET on the server.
integrationPanel.oauthMetaUnavailable: Requires META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET; redirect URI must match Meta Developer Console (META_REDIRECT_URI or default /api/auth/channel/meta/callback).
integrationPanel.oauthShopeeUnavailable: Requires SHOPEE_PARTNER_ID and SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY; register redirect on Shopee Open Platform (SHOPEE_REDIRECT_URI or default callback). Set SHOPEE_USE_TEST=1 for sandbox.
integrationPanel.pilotNoOAuth: Telegram: no in-app OAuth yet — mark when your bot or server is wired.
integrationPanel.shippingApisBody: GHN: mainly via environment variables. GHTK: prefer saving token + addresses below; otherwise env vars are used for live quotes on the Shipping page.
integrationPanel.ghtkSectionBody: Enter API token and pick/receiver addresses; we call the fee API once before saving. The token is not shown again after save.
integrationPanel.ghtkSaveError: Save failed — check token and addresses, or try again later.
integrationPanel.ghtkStoredHint: GHTK API token is saved on this server (SQLite).
integrationPanel.openGhtkSeller: Open GHTK portal (sign in, copy API token)
integrationPanel.ghtkSellerHint: Sign in to your shop on the GHTK portal, open API / settings, copy the token, then paste it below.
integrationPanel.envHintBody: Zalo OA: ZALO_OA_APP_ID, ZALO_OA_APP_SECRET, ZALO_OA_REDIRECT_URI (or default callback). Facebook: META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_REDIRECT_URI. Shopee: SHOPEE_PARTNER_ID, SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY, SHOPEE_REDIRECT_URI; SHOPEE_USE_TEST=1 for sandbox. Zalo webhook: URL shown under the Zalo card.

oauthFlash.zalo_oauth_ok: Zalo OA connected — token saved on the server.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_ok: Facebook connected — token saved; Messenger webhook is a separate later step.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_err: Facebook returned an error — try again or check Meta Developer settings.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_bad_state: Invalid Facebook OAuth session — try signing in again.
oauthFlash.meta_oauth_exchange_fail: Facebook code exchange failed — check META_APP_SECRET and redirect URI.
oauthFlash.shopee_oauth_bad: Invalid Shopee OAuth parameters — try authorizing again.
oauthFlash.shopee_oauth_fail: Shopee authorization failed — check partner id/key and registered redirect.

errors.quota: The assistant is temporarily out of processing quota. Please retry in a few minutes.

aiChat.gatewayOffline: VClaw AI is **off** — set `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` in the browser (same value as `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` in VClaw). Legacy `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` still works. The `/api/gateway` proxy reads `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN` or `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`. Menus still work; in chat try **products**, **orders**, **onboarding**, or **what works**.

healthCheck.banner: This app cannot reach the gateway at {baseUrl} (HTTP {status}). Check OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL, that the gateway process is running (Zero Token: ./server.sh after onboard), and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN if /health returns 401.
healthCheck.unreachable: Network error calling {baseUrl}. Confirm the gateway host is reachable from the Next.js server and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL has no typo.

openclawStatus.title: VClaw Token

actionDescriptions.missing_token: Add the gateway token to env vars, then refresh health.
actionDescriptions.unauthorized: Re-check the gateway token between VClaw and the gateway process, then try again.
actionDescriptions.unreachable: Check the gateway process, REST/WS ports, and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL.
actionDescriptions.missing_catalog: Load web-model config or the Zero Token sample config, then refresh health.
actionDescriptions.auth_unusable: Run webauth or sign in to the web provider again, then refresh health.
actionDescriptions.runtime_not_web: Switch the default model or current session to a *-web/* provider, then re-check.
actionDescriptions.runtime_unknown: Inspect session status or the gateway default config to confirm the runtime model.
